Ten-byte supply/registration fixtures add only Berry Pots and five Oran Berries to exact ROM/RAM-matched isolated copies. Native UI plants and exits; no RTC, Pokemon, pot or growth state is edited. All fixture definitions and ancestry are recorded.
Actual native growth covers one unmulched Oran seed to sprout per game and its native save/cold preservation. Other berries, mulch, harvest/regrowth and broad long-play acceptance remain pending.

Runtime timed-table acceptance covers new Route29 visible Pidgey/Sentret at world daytime with native RTC at midnight. SS also starts with native night Hoothoot/Rattata and passes retained-Rattata contact and flee while HUD is disabled. Wider tables/special encounters and time-based evolution UI remain pending.

HUD runtime covers free field, enhancement/party/native-save menus, Berry Pots app, Route29-NewBark connection and SS ordinary battle/flee. Broader layouts/maps/menus/special tasks and long-session acceptance remain pending.

Offline 120x resume equation is checked against saved journal anchor, native RTC and exact extra-bonus delta; active elapsed seconds are inferred from that delta. Cold 1x resume is exact and adds no extra Berry bonus.
The independent clock deliberately leaves native Pokegear RTC, calendar/daily events and penalty bookkeeping under native rules. It is a DS adaptation, not a 3DS renderer or DSP implementation.
All other unfinished inventory work remains in the full goal. These candidates are experimental, not final releases.
